title: Emi's office on B2
caption: The copy room is cut in two by a partition: the left part is now Emi's office with its own doorway from the corridor, and the copier keeps the right part. On day 2 Emi sits at her own desk there instead of standing in the lift lobby. Issue #238.

sections.title: Before
sections.caption: One big copy room; on day 2 Emi waited in the lift lobby.

sections.title: After
sections.caption: Her desk with a nameplate エミ / EMI, a monitor, lamp, folders and mug; a guest chair on a rug; a backlit coast panel for a window and a calendar on the wall behind her; a cabinet with a team photo and a plant, prints over a bookcase, a coat stand, a filing cabinet and a tall plant.

images.caption: Emi at her desk, close, desktop
The copy room now: copier, fax and paper shelf along the partition, a smaller worktable
